status.summary: Ranked #3 at middleweight and 5-0 (1 NC) since his Jan 2023 loss to Sean Strickland; pro record 17-4 (1 NC). Last fought Sep 6, 2025 (unanimous decision over Caio Borralho, UFC Paris). He has waited about 14 months for a title shot at champion Strickland: MMA Junkie's Mike Bohn reported in late October 2026 that the rematch is targeted for February 2027 'somewhere in Florida' and is close to signed (Last Word on Sports names UFC 337), but it had not been announced as of Nov 3, 2026, and an earlier December date fell through over Strickland's pay dispute. In October he confronted Strickland at the UFC Performance Institute and offered $500k of his own money to get the fight made. No injuries reported.

style.summary: A tall, jab-first orthodox striker who controls range with footwork and fast straight punches, then wins the late rounds of five-round fights. His counter-wrestling has become a strength: he stuffed 9 of 10 Brendan Allen takedowns in 2024. He uses his own wrestling for control less than most middleweights (13.7% control share decayed vs about 18% for the division).

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 76.6% head, 14.7% body, 8.7% leg (career 77.5/14.7/7.8). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he is a near-typical head hunter who kicks the legs rarely. Inside the head group the jab leads, because Wikipedia and the Sherdog scouting report describe a footwork-and-jab game. The cross is second for the right hand that KO'd Adesanya. Hooks, uppercuts and head kicks stay small; no source highlights them. Body weights are split evenly because ufcstats does not separate punches from kicks. Leg kicks are rare but accurate (14/18 vs Borralho). Elbow 0.15 reflects the short close-range elbow highlighted in the Sherdog scouting report. Knee 0.15 reflects his 12% clinch share of sig landed and the 'hard knees in the clinch' noted in the MMA Mania breakdown that Wikipedia cites (raised from 0.1 on Nov 6, 2026). No spinning attacks are reported.

engine_notes.note: Output climbs late in five-round fights: sig landed per minute is 1.18x R1 in R4 and 1.21x in R5 (pace array). He outlanded Borralho 24-12 in R4 and Cannonier 28-17 in R2 before the R4 stoppage.
No knockdowns absorbed and no KO losses in 12 UFC fights.
Takedown defense is 86.7% decayed (opponents 1.9 of 14.4) and 81% career; Allen went 1 of 10 against him.
